contents.text: I'm looking at the stat summary from ShowCommit, which covers what the last commit changed. Since the user asked to see the changes, the stat along with the commit message seems like a fair answer, and I could offer the full diff too.

The last commit is `d1cbf99`, by Louis Marais on Fri Nov 27 2026. Its message is "docs(f97.3): step 10a - the docs say how a chat finds a tool when it's needed."

It changed 8 files, with 162 insertions and 24 deletions. All of it is documentation, plus one generated interface description:

- **`src/docs/projects/LouisAgent.Core.md`** (+36 lines): adds part 16, covering what waits, who decides, FindTool, and the strategy below the replay. Also adds the `TOOL_SEARCH` setting and four new folders in the structure.
- **`src/docs/projects/LouisAgent.Core.Anthropic.md`** (+20 lines): adds part 6 on `defer_loading`, `tool_reference`, and why the server-side search isn't used.
- **`LouisAgent.Core.Anthropic-interface.json`** and **`.svg`**: the interface picture gains a fifth seam and is redrawn. The JSON changed by 78 lines and the SVG by 41.
- **`src/docs/SETUP.md`**, **`src/docs/architecture/05-building-block-view.md`**, and **`src/docs/guides/run-an-eval.md`** (+5 lines): smaller follow-on updates.
- **`src/engine/LouisAgent.Core/CLAUDE.md`** (4 lines changed): updated to match.

The commit message says the close-out (write-up, work log, TODO, and folding in the plan) waits for step 9's "after" run. So this is an intermediate step, not the finished feature.

I only looked at the stat summary, not the line-by-line diff. If you want the actual text changes in any of these files, I can pull the full diff.
